description: This file is a Perl script that generates firmware images for Broadcom-based devices. It includes functions for reading image files, padding data, and creating a custom image format called bcmImage, which involves packing headers and concatenating kernel and root filesystem images. The script appears to be a replacement for a tool called 'brcmImagebuilder' and supports various command-line options for customizing the image creation process.

methods.name: Read_Image
methods.description: Reads the entire contents of a file specified by filename into a scalar and returns it.

methods.name: Padlen
methods.description: Calculates the padding length needed to align data size to a specified block size.

methods.name: Pad
methods.description: Pads a buffer with 0xFF bytes to reach a specific length based on offset and block size.

methods.name: bcmImage
methods.description: Creates a custom firmware image by constructing headers, packing images, and writing to output file.
